summary: Held curl at version 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8 on node1. The hold and package version persisted across a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Captured the initial curl version and boot identity.
Applied the native APT package hold to curl.
Verified both APT and dpkg report curl as held.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified curl remained installed, functional, and held at the same version after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
evidence.summary: curl was initially 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8; the hold was applied and verified through both apt-mark and dpkg before and after restart.

Captured boot ID 4b43f122-6c8b-4c87-b01a-12705c4a9f4f, acknowledged the scheduled restart, observed new boot ID d129d7cd-a574-482e-ac42-7e431a9f2187, and confirmed the system was running with curl functional and its hold intact.
